style_authority.note: Centers a calm, repeatedly used web operations sheet and makes direct control, immediate re-grab, stable task context, and legible snap state the motion policy.

reference_selection.note: Applies motion quality, interaction physics, pointer ownership, transform tracking, interruption, accessibility, performance tracing, responsive validation, and device evidence.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Keeps causal pointer feedback, 1:1 displacement, short settle, and non-spatial state feedback while rejecting transition-all, layout animation, whole-sheet scale, input lockout, and decorative bounce.

evidence_level.note: Labels the critique L0 static and avoids claiming observed smoothness, frame rate, computed-style priority, touch conflict, responsiveness, or device results.

verified_boundary.note: Separates source-visible control flow and missing branches from unverified geometry, cascade behavior, performance cost, gesture arbitration, external accessibility code, browsers, and devices.

design_moves.note: Provides eight moves covering handle feedback, pointer capture, grab-offset transform tracking, interruption, CSS-px/s velocity handoff, bounded authorized projection, resistance, and Reduced Motion, but does not define snap-target hysteresis.

scope_control.note: Remains read-only and motion-specific with five findings and eight moves, but contains 163 logical lines, exceeding the 150-line cap by 13 lines.
